name: Rainy city night
one_line: Wet streets, a few warm windows, light kept low.
look_words: A city street in the rain at night, with the light held back. Blue-grey asphalt, darker walls, pale pavement; a handful of warm amber windows and one or two pale teal lamps, each reflected in the wet ground. Most of the screen is dark and quiet, so each light matters. Shapes are tall and plain with overhead wires and awnings. The player wears a yellow raincoat, the brightest thing on the street. Amber marks places to go and things to take, teal marks the goal, red means harm. Motion is rain: fine streaks, ripples in puddles, drips from edges, a passing tram. Avoid neon signs, purple and pink glow, bloom, lens flares and crushed black.

palette.name: rain at night
palette.notes: The "sun" is a weak cool sky light; warm light should come from lamps and windows you place. Keep accents few.

look_wish: soft painted shading with wet reflections, or none

upgrade.why: wet night air that lifts far buildings toward the sky colour

music.mood: slow, muted trumpet and electric piano

sound_feel: rain on metal and cloth, tyres on wet road, a far siren, drips

frames.prompt: Rainy city street at night with restrained light, third-person camera behind a small courier in a yellow raincoat holding an umbrella, walking wet cobbles past shuttered shopfronts with plain blank awnings and one warm lit window. Dark blue-grey buildings, a few soft amber and pale teal lamps reflected in puddles, fine rain, overhead wires, a parked bicycle. Muted, moody, calm. Shop fronts are plain with no signs and no lettering anywhere. Stylised painted 3D. Gameplay view of a stylised indie video game, no text, no user interface, no logos, no watermark.
